meta_description: Shine Plastering in Sheffield delivers expert internal and external plastering work. Fast turnarounds, competitive pricing. Call 07707 982057 for a free quote.
hero_subhead: From patch repairs to complete replastering, we deliver smooth, long-lasting finishes on time and on budget.
services_subhead: We handle everything from small repairs to full property replastering, using quality materials and proven techniques.

services.title: Internal Plastering
services.desc: Ceiling and wall plastering for new builds and renovations. We deliver perfectly smooth finishes ready for decoration.

services.title: External Rendering
services.desc: Durable weatherproof renders that protect your property and enhance curb appeal. Bespoke colour finishes available.

services.title: Patch Repairs
services.desc: Quick fixes for cracks, holes, and damaged plaster. We match existing finishes so repairs blend seamlessly.

services.title: Artex Removal
services.desc: Safe removal of textured coatings with professional finish options. Transforms dated ceilings in days.

services.title: Dry Lining & Skimming
services.desc: Modern dry lining systems for insulation and speed, finished with a professional skim coat for a polished look.

services.title: Specialist Finishes
services.desc: Polished plaster, lime mortar, and decorative coatings. We specialise in heritage and bespoke finishes for character properties.

about_pullquote: Good plastering shouldn't be expensive or take forever. We keep it simple and honest.
about_para_1: Shine Plastering was founded on frustration. After watching good tradespeople undercut by cowboys, we decided to offer honest pricing, reliable timescales, and proper workmanship. Over 12 years we've built a loyal following across Sheffield, Rotherham, and the surrounding areas—plastering new builds, renovating period properties, and fixing other people's mistakes.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we do what we say: turn up on time, finish to a high standard, and leave the site clean. We listen to what you need—whether that's a quick repair to let a property sell, or a complete interior replastering before you move in. We're not the cheapest, but we're fair, and we're reliable.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had the whole downstairs re-plastered before Christmas and it was brilliant. Mark and the lads were dead professional, cleaned up every day, and finished bang on schedule. New year and new walls. Wouldn't hesitate to recommend.
reviews.author: David H.

reviews.text: Patched up a nightmare crack in the living room plaster that kept coming back. Called Shine and they came out next day, sorted it properly, matched the finish perfectly. Fair price too. Top work.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Artex removal is never fun but these lads made it painless. Safe, quick, and the ceiling looks amazing now. Already asked them back for the kitchen wall. Genuine professionals.
reviews.author: Paul T.
